title: Western Balkans 6: Albania Country Climate and Development Report Compendium
temporal_coverage: Climate and socioeconomic data, historical hazards through 2023, municipal hazard rankings and policy review.
methodology: World Bank compendium combines climate, infrastructure and socioeconomic data, scenario analysis and policy review.
limitations: Municipal scores are aggregate and modeled; they are not household-level risk or conflict estimates.

title: Albania's National Adaptation Plan 2026–2036
organization: Government of Albania, Ministry of Environment, with UNDP and Green Climate Fund support
temporal_coverage: National climate risks and an adaptation framework for 2026–2036; municipal plans developed during 2022–2024.
methodology: National plan synthesizes sector and municipal climate-risk assessments and prioritizes adaptation measures.
limitations: Municipal profiles summarize underlying plans; targets and risk ratings are not independent implementation evaluations.

title: National Security Strategy of the Republic of Albania 2023–2028
organization: Republic of Albania, Ministry of Defence
temporal_coverage: National security strategy for 2023–2028; relevant climate-security passage addresses global-level risks.
methodology: Official strategy assesses global, regional and national security risks and institutional responses.
limitations: Climate-security passages are global risk framing, not Albania-specific empirical causal findings.

title: Local Climate Change Adaptation Plan for Shkoder Municipality: Project Summary
temporal_coverage: Local adaptation planning project delivered June–October 2025.
methodology: One-page summary from the implementing institute reports plan outputs and partners.
limitations: The summary does not include the full hazard analysis or independently evaluated adaptation results.

title: ALBAdapt: Climate-Resilient Urban Development Programme
organization: Republic of Albania, Ministry of Environment
temporal_coverage: Programme components and expected beneficiaries reported in July 2026.
methodology: Ministry programme announcement describes planned components and expected reach; text translated from Albanian.
limitations: Programme intentions and beneficiary targets are not measured results.
